page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top; page number top right; no margin notes. Below the text block, a catchword-like signature line "P 5" and "VVilt" appear at the foot of the column, treated as catchword.

main_text.p: Dum hæc contingerent in Geldria, Zutphania, Transilvania, Frisiaq; Amerfordiense quoque præsidium, sub Gilberto à Broeckhuysen, & Andrea Putman præfectis rebellavit, addictis minis, tradituros se civitatem Frederico quam primum adventarer. Discessere itaque præfecti, cum duobus militum vexillis, & 50 circiter equitibus Amerffordio, & Naerdam accessere, ingressum flagitantes, sed repulsam passi sunt.
Ad Comitem de Bossu Vltraiectum profecti Amerfordienses, oblatisque clavibus veniam petiere. Venit 21 Novemb. cum duobus vexillis, & civitatem ipsorum occupavit.
main_text.head: Historica relatio cladis ac destructionis Naerdensis, Imperatore Regij exercitus Frederico Ducis Albæ filio, Kalendis Decemb. 1572.
main_text.p: VRbis Naerdæ incolæ ac cives cum induxissent animum coniungere se cum diversis aliis urbibus Hollandiæ, Zelandiæ ac Frisiæ, quæ ab Albano defciverant, ut Hispanicum jugum possent excutere, & propugnare Religionem, privilegia & immunitates suas, factus est certior Comes de Bossu à proditoribus aliquibus: Quapropter is 20 Augusti 1572 mane circa octavam horam, cum quatuor Germanicorum peditum vexillis Vltraiecto discedens partem ipsorum Naerdam, partem vero Amstelodamum inducere sperabat. Vt autem celaret Naerdenses relicta ordinaria via per alios anfractus profectus est.
Accidit tamen ut eodem die post meridiem Amerfordio, quo jam de Comite fama pervenerat, ad dictas civitates milites VValones qui sub Centurione S. Marij militabant venirent Ductu Lamberti Ianfz.

page.notes: The first letter V of the chapter opening is a large initial. Marginal and printed signature marks ("P 5", "VVilt") at the foot are read as the catchword and signature area; "P 5" is a gathering mark and was omitted from the text. Section letter of the chapter head is not printed. The word "Transilvania" in the source reads "Transfelania" and was transcribed as printed.
